doc.title: Greg Caputo interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 14, 1998

chapter: Views on drummers and the state of jazz
title: State of jazz today
summary: He sees a resurgence of jazz at colleges and among young players.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future

blocks.x: What do you think of the state of jazz today?

I think that CDs — LPs being reissued on CDs, I definitely think there’s a resurgence. At colleges, many big bands, big interest in jazz. I play a club and I look out there and I see younger players. Younger players will talk to the jazz masters, drive three, four hundred
miles to hear somebody, their idol, follow them around, study with them. I think there’s a big surgence. It’s apple pie, jazz is a Americana.
